reviews.text:
Hello all, I wanted to leave a review for the lovely vet who helped us say goodbye to our beloved cat Blue today.

She was so kind, gentle and comforting, both to our cat and to us during such a heartbreaking moment.I was so emotional at the time that I forgot to properly say thank you, but I really want her to know how much her compassion and kindness meant to us. She made an incredibly difficult experience just a little easier.

Thank you so much,  for taking such wonderful care of our cat and for being so compassionate when I needed it most. ❤️

Just called after monitoring my cat's reaction to food that was suggeted by them. THEIR plan was to see how he reacts, then hear from me in order to reccommend further dietry plan.
But when I called, the student vet on the phone didn't know much about anything. The other vet couldn't talk.
When I asked to speak with ANY of the vets who treated my cat previouly (like last month) I was told "they dont work here". What? So no one knows anything about the patient, eccept for the email exchange - which stated that I need to call and get advice. No one could give a simple advice OR call me later, becauyse "they dont work there". Anything to get me to book another appointment!
They used to be much better a few years back, with personal care and knowledge. They've gone down massively.
I fill the newcross branch isn't a very welcome vets to visit . After 30 years of visiting this branch .

Overall, our visit was positive and Logan was treated with care and respect. The clinic was clean and had a noticeable disinfectant smell, which was reassuring. The bill was settled quickly and the team were helpful throughout.

A few areas could be improved to enhance the experience: our appointment ran a few minutes behind schedule, and the reception area and shelves looked a little sparse, giving the impression the clinic was either newly opened or winding down for the day. Additionally, the website doesn’t currently allow us to amend existing pet information, which would be a useful feature.
The vet I saw was really accommodating and caring.  I fuond the experience of getting an appointment frustrating.
Good service

very good friendly staff and appointment kept, no waiting.
very happy at this practice.

Friendly reception and medical staff, who clearly care about animals and their human friends. Nicely air conditioned waiting room. Helpful, expert vet who carried one of my 2 cats in and out for a routine checkup.

I had one of the most stressing vet visit ever, I bring my cat in to cut her claws as I can’t do it on my own as she is getting agitated, I explained this to the vet and then she said she will wrap her in a towel try to cut her claws, she came back and she told me she managed to cut only the back claws and that I have to get her medicine for her to calm down and then to come back to cut the front paws claws, she told me I have to pay full price even if she didn’t cut them fully and she cut the back ones Wich everyone knows that a cat use her front claws to scratch, and then they told me I have to pay a full price next time plus the medication they charged me 36 pounds for cutting only the back claws Wich realistically wasn’t harming anyone I feel this was such an horrible and stressful experience for me Wich I explained everything to them from the start they never said about the pills from before and they put me to pay for a service that wasn’t basically done at all . Plus I had to wait over 20 minutes even tho I had an appointment

We had a health scare with our cat, Mimi, which led booking a next day, 6pm appointment at Medivet New Cross.
The next day the receptionist called just before 2pm, and informed that the vet seen my notes of my cat’s symptoms and wants to see my cat earlier. A 3pm appointment was offered which I gladly accepted. This made me feel cared, both the vet and the receptionist, Simona understood how worrying can be when our furry friends are unwell.
Upon arrival we had wait about 5mins for the vet (totally acceptable for me) and once we were in the room, she did a very throughout check on my cat. She offered but not pushed for a blood test too. She very informative with me and very gentle with my cat. Sadly I haven’t catch her full name, but she was wonderful.
Mimi was given the all clear and later that afternoon the vet called me to let me know that my cat’s blood test results were all good. I can’t wish for a better care, thank you!

Beware if you use this practice and keep receipts for everything. They raised a billing issue with me over two years after the appointment, long after I had moved and stopped using them.

By leaving it so long, they took away any opportunity for me to properly challenge what they now claim happened at the appointment. I'm simply expected to accept their version of events years later and make additional payment, despite having no way to verify it myself.

I find it unacceptable that a professional practice can come back years later and effectively add treatments to an appointment when there is no longer any realistic way for a customer to dispute it. Their administration and record-keeping have left me with very little confidence in the practice.
Appointment on time. The vet we saw was very pleasent and a very good with our cat. Reasonable price for a booster jab.

I came back after a few years to this clinic after my previous cat died. They still had wrong data in their system even if I had already settled every payment.
The vet used their trick of using extra tools to check my cat health without telling me in advance the price and making me believe it would have been included in the general check. This is their usual behaviour here in my experience and probably due to mandate to make profit for the big corporation. I had to suggest to check ears and weight to the vet. I’m surprised it didn’t come from them.
Always lovely with my dog. Very fair and explain everything
Bad experience, terrible customer service, lack of consideration and poor advice.
Excellent service! Thank you!

Always very happy with the care from NX Medivets - and have been for the past 25 years!

However, I had hoped for some feedback from recent blood test results thyroid levels for Tocco Magico ?
Erica Fitzpatrick

I have the membership which entitles me to a 10% discount, but didn't receive a 10% discount. I barely received a 2% discount. When I asked the receptionist about this, I was told:
"The system calculates it. Anyway, it is only a few pounds [it was £15], so why are you making a fuss?"
The next time, I'll underpay by £15, and we'll see how small a deal it is. Or perhaps you can reduce her wages by £15, and see how little she complains.

I have no issues with the actual vet,  but the receptionist is the face of the practice.
Great team
Friendly professional members of staff, very thorough & efficient
The staff Use to be very friendly, but not friendly any more,wait untill the healhplan finish im not going to continue.

I can’t say we’ve always had the best service at this clinic, however on the 21st of March we had the vet Adam who was outstanding.

Both my partner and I immediately felt at ease and immediately warmed at heart when our cat Nala happily sat with him, his warmth and rappel building with our pet and ourselves was so appreciated.

We’ve recently had so many issues with our cats ears and we really appreciated Adam taking the time to show us how to clean them and look for yeast.

Great service and a true cat charmer thank you so much it made our day!
Overall the service is good and the practice is clean.
Medivet New Cross have been a great support with a new pet owner (!) and my pet has been very happy with them. Recommended for first time pet owners
Went to New Cross Medvet  as Dulwich was closed for flooding. I had to pick up some tablets for the dog. Always a good service

The vet was nice but the appointment was delayed 15 minutes we arrived early so we were waiting for some time , when we finally got called and our pet got her checkup they tried to charge use alot more than what was actually supposed to be payed. At medivet them themselves have posted that the first appointment is free for pets under 1 year our pet met this criteria but when we told them they claimed it's false , the vet let us of saying it wasn't true , but it is , you can search online and look on the actual website . There was lot of miscommunication between the staff and the customers , would not attend again.

The service received by the receptionist with the Italian accent was very very poor. She failed to book my appointment as requested for a 6 month health check and consultation.
She had trouble understanding me and failed to give me the correct information which I eventually obtained from another receptionist. The quality of her service was very poor. She slammed the phone down on 2 occasions when ending my calls. I asked her to confirm why there was a difference in the charges I paid for in this appointment and the last. She struggled and was unable give a clear explanation. Overall she was quite rude in tone and attitude. I called back today to ask for my pets medical records. And noticed that the same receptionist had written a consultation in the records that wasn’t accurate true. Hopefully I dont receive service like that from her or anyone ever again. Additionally - I used the services of this vet for more than 20 years when it used to be called John Hankinson.  The quality of service there isn’t the best. The staff  turn over seems to be quite high and cost for their services seem to be increasing and not matching the customer experience and service.

They don't seem to care about their clients.

Got a large quote from them to perform some extractions for our cat. Supposedly needs to be done asap.

We had questions. Called 3 times on 3 different days asking to speak to a vet or have one call us.
No one phoned.

Have found a different vet.
Got a quick appointment  staff  caring and attentive very satisfied

Been using Medivet New Cross for three years with my Staffy.  Always find the staff pleasant and take their time.  Appointments are easy to arrange with helpful reminders when they are due.  We use the Pet Plan, which includes health checks every six months, annual vaccinations and monthly worming tablets - it is good value.
Really friendly staff! You always feel like your pet is cared for. It’s easy to get or amend appointments. Would highly recommend!

I don't like leaving negative reviews, but I want to warn any animal parents to stay away from Medivet if they want to keep their babies healthy and alive. Last year I left my cat for a spaying surgery only to receive the worst imaginable call in my life, they cut the wrong tube and my cat required a lifesaving surgery that involved kidney removal in order to survive. I brought them a happy and healthy kitty and left with a kitty with one kidney.  Luckily, the vet surgeon from Davies Vet Specialists where she was transported saved her precious life. Moreover, they promised that they were going to cover all the expenses connected to any procedures needed in order to monitor her kidney and they did not keep their promise either, we kept paying during every visit for her kidney health check and they tried to keep pushing me to pay £500 for blood tests and this was the last straw for me. At least you could have kept your promise to look after her health. I'm still very lucky that my baby girl didn't die because of their negligence...
Love this vets always very friendly and care so much about Teddy Would recommend 1000%

My 17yrs Millie sadly passed on the morning of Sunday 21st September. She become ill 3 weeks earlier with shallow breathing and loss of appetite. I had 3 appointments in 2 weeks and on all 3 occasion I was seen by a different veterinarian, all advised me to get her a heart scan. The first estimate given was £860(with over stay at the clinic) On my 2nd visit I was quoted £1200 and on my 3rd visit I was given an estimation of £1800!!!!
They refused to prescribe Millie ANY heart medication unless a scan was done.

I went to another independent veterinary clinic and was told they could prescribe medication to help with Millies breathing.

To give context why I was hesitated. 6 year ago I had a 10 yr old pomeranian called Rocco who had similar breathing issues (common in the breed) as Millie. JH had advised me Rocco need a blood test, heart scan and X-ray to help determine and to resolve this issue. I was given a rough estimate for the entire procedure including medication of £1,000 to £1200 which I agreed to. The final cost was over £1500 and Rocco passed 10 days later.

Been with JH for over 10 years and they have become a money grab. Ever since Medivet took over the service have become money first!

6 month of cat flee treatment was over 100 pounds!!! When I questioned why it was so expensive the receptionist reluctantly said I could get a prescription and buy the treatment from an online pharmacy. The cost of prescription was 25 pounds (why??) , 6 month flee treatment was just over 35 pounds. Do your own maths.
Absolutely ridiculous. I am very glad to hear that the vet sector is finally being pushed by the regulators to publish AND justify their prices.
In the meantime do ask for prescription - it still works out cheaper.
The team are very caring and friendly. My pup, Headley, loves going there.
Thank you for rating us. Your feedback is really appreciated.
Extremely happy with service and staff are very friendly too.

Normally pretty good, although we rarely see the same vet twice and insurance requests are not always put through in a timely manner, or at all. It's way too expensive, too, of course. But then so is everything else.
Excellent service. Very knowledgeable and helpful vet.
Staff are friendly and and very helpful. My pet did not want to leave there today . Surely that shows how well treated the pets are

Pleasant and clinical practice. It was easy to book an appointment and the staff team were friendly and welcoming. It would be good if itemised billing can be provided so customers can understand exactly what is being paid for.

Receptionist unhelpful, bored sounding and sarcastic. I actually had to hang up because of her rudeness. I would suggest she gets a different job where she doesn't have to work with the public, as it's clearly not her thing
Worst vet ever. Gives you outstanding balances you’re not even aware about .. overly pricey for no reason. very very useless
The staff are top people know there stuff and are very friendly. 😁 …

Be careful and upfront about any additional costs that may be added to your bill. There’s a growing concern around vet clinics taking advantage of customers, especially during the cost of living crisis.

I’ve been forced to book an appointment just to get medication we regularly use for many years and that works for us. I was then charged four times more than the medication’s online price. Getting a prescription instead comes with an extra fee, but it still works out cheaper overall if you buy the medication online.

That said, you need to be proactive and communicate this clearly with the vet, as they just add charges without warning. I told my vet that my budget was tight, yet I still wasn’t advised to get a prescription and buy the medication elsewhere. £45 for ear-drops that actually cost £10. I will be looking into raising a complaint about unfair vet charges as I just felt absolutely exploited by this company. It’s unregulated and cruel.

Never have I experienced such a universally kind and caring medical practice. It’s palpable to me how much the staff care about - even love - my boy. And he enjoys going to the vet so much that he’s borderline depressed when it’s time to leave. Only half joking when I say I wish I could be a patient as well 😅

Thank you to each of you at Medivet New Cross! My family is grateful for you 🐾♥️🐶
Sara (now on maternity leave) and David have been great with our two Whippets. Thanks Nick

I have been a client at new cross Medivet for a short time, yet they have managed to mess up almost every time I go. The staff is borderline incompetent with terrible communication. They sent my cat home with a catheter still in his arm after his castration.  which was incredibly dangerous, not to mention, medical negligence. We were not offered compensation for this.
This week my cat fell ill and my partner took him in for a urine and blood test where he then payed up front as part of a package deal that was quoted by the vet. Over the next couple days we recieved multiple calls from Medivet staff requiring us to pay more over the phone. When I told them that I was on vacation and do not want to be disturbed they continued to call me to ask for money, despite my partner already paying the day before. The receptionist who spoke to me today was extremely dismissive toward my frustration. I am very disappointed at the service at Medivet new cross and I will be changing vets.

Wonderful experience with this practice for annual jabs for my two dogs. I highly recommended them as they are able to see the two dogs in one appointment which is much easier all round. I had a really lovely vet and she was very helpful with all my questions. 10 out of 10 service

I just want to say thank you to the entire team for their ongoing support, especially recently during what has been a stressful time with our dog Pasha, who is needing multiple surgeries. Every member of the staff has been kind and professional, and we’re especially grateful to vets David and Sara, as well as Claire at the front desk.

Pasha is a very fearful rescue and can be a challenge to manage, so we’re incredibly appreciative of the patience, care, and understanding the team have shown him throughout.

I have always found the availability and flexibility with appointments great at this practice, and the front desk team always take time to follow-up and answer questions over email - not to mention the team helping us write to the insurance company to support our claim dispute, despite their incredibly busy and demanding days. Thank you again.
Excellent service as always......
Easy to make an appointment on line now.  Friendly vet made our nervous cat calm and comfortable.

I have been a customer of Medivet New Cross for 7 years, biut today I have never encountered such rude customer service. I called to get my cat's  medical history. As I tried to explain why I was leaving (due to the poor service of the Medivet branch near my new home, who didn't answer the phone after 30 mins of waiting) I was interrupted by the receptionist 3 times "NAME"..."SURNAME"...she even interrupted me to say "SPELL IT" as I was spelling it. At the end of the call I explained to her that she had been incredibly rude was just told “Thank you Bye”

7 years I’ve been with Medivet New Cross, but if this is the way they treat loyal customers who happen to be leaving, imagine how they will treat your pet. The receptionist I spoke to should be ashamed. What an awful way to behave.

Great vet and costumer service
Very professional and helpful
Been our vet for years, still wonderful

Receptionist most unhelpful, refused to ring cab, said as she was only one had to man phone, then disappeared for several minutes and the phone was ringing like mad. Vet wore mask and it was hard to understand what she was saying as she was oriental. Not at all satisfied with this practice.
Doctor Nicole Lim was great and my cat recovered quickly after her dental surgery.
Very friendly staff. My cat was very well cared for ☺️

It was the worst experience I have had so far with vet booking appointments. I called the vet today around 1pm and got appointment today at 5:30. I explained in the phone that dog has not eaten for a day and today either and her is stomach making noises.
My partner went there with the sick dog and turned away saying that we don't have appointments!!! I received a text message and because I was at work I could not call immediately. He couldn't see a vet they didn't even offered and got a new appointment for tomorrow.
When I got informed about around 6 pm I called the vet immediately. The reception put the phone down on me at first, when I called back and she picked up the phone she knew it was me and apologized for the booking and said they offered my partner to stay and wait if it's urgent. But they didn't!!! It's a lie, she also said I can go to the pet hospital if it's that urgent!!!! What kind of service is that!!!!?????? Seriously????

Most horrendous answered I got back from head nurse that everything was actually my fault and if my dog was feeling that bad I could have gone to the pet hospital. The receptionist was rude and unprofessional and the head nurse didn't any remorse regarding the situation.
I'm with neighbourhood vet, I could recommend their service anyone. Penge branch is good, but Dulwich branch is 5 star!!!
Stay away from new cross medivet!!!!
Sara at Medivet New Cross has been professional and caring throughout consultations, surgery and related aftercare for my cat and achieved an excellent result. Reception have been lovely.

I am grateful to the team for offering the slot to my cat Rosie as that was an emergency as she was unwell. Thanks to Medivet New Cross my cat Rosie is getting better now.

Lovely stuff, smiling and great Vet David helped a lot.

Thank you so much - Great team work
Highly recommend!

Kind regards,
Aneta Kozakiewicz

I don’t usually write reviews, but I felt compelled to share my recent experience with Medivet New Cross. I called them seeking guidance on a lost cat we found, as multiple friends recommended speaking to the local vet and we don’t have a cat carrier to bring it to the vet. Unfortunately, I was met with unsympathetic responses from the reception staff, who seemed unwilling to offer any helpful suggestions. After asking several questions, I was bluntly told to “get a box” and then abruptly hung up on with a “bye.” The interaction was frankly rude and disappointing, especially since we were just trying to return a lovely cat to its home.
All good as usual. Great practice with very friendly staff. Astro ☄️ enjoyed his experience 😺 …

We loved our experience at Medivet in Newcross. Clean and professional. Vet was extremely helpful and supportive with the right things for my pregnant cat who also had young kittys with her at our visit! (Yes! She’s been busy!) Vet was lovely, and gentle. Ladies at the desk were friendly and amazing too! Gave me great tips and advice. Broke down the health care plan of my cat and her kittys! Would highly recommend.

I visited Medivet Catford in Jan 2024 but I was registered with Medivet New cross at that time. My pet's treatment was amazing in Medivet Catford. I would infact personally want to thank the Vet for her brilliant management. …

I've always had amazing service at Medivet New Cross, the vets are so kind and thorough in their care and explaining aftercare. The reception staff are lovely and have always gone above and beyond when I've needed help - replying super quickly to emails and booking in last minute appointments. Would definitely recommend them

the worst vet I have ever been to in my entire life.

My dog ​​has been unwell for 1 week, I paid £300 for tests that took a week. …

I would like to say a big thank you to the staff who dealt with Bella(my dog). I don't think I could ask for any better. It's been a really hard day. I called medivet around 14:40pm. Frantically concerned about my dog. Spoke to a lovely …
